nameOrigin: sharp feather used for writing with ink

pokedexEntries.la: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

pokedexEntries.sc: Overqwil’s poisonous spikes will reflexively react even while Overqwil sleeps, stabbing any moving thing that approaches.

pokedexEntries.vi: It’s ferocious and has a short temper. The ends of its spikes are barbed, and they can’t be easily removed once they’ve punctured something.

pokedexEntries.za: Overqwil's poisonous spikes-now thicker, longer, and stronger-will automatically strike toward anything that moves.
